authorization: Finish the narrow Windows path policy fix following Ferreiro quota exhaustion. No IPC, manifest, dependency, lockfile, sessions.rs or job_object.rs changes. No heavy cargo check/test/build/clippy, push, or new CI before independent review and Regente decision.

findings: All 23 Rust tests passed (12 sessions tests, 4 storage tests, 7 path_policy tests) in CI on Windows Server 2025; path prefix and fail-closed fixes verified.
Clippy failed solely on manual_pattern_char_comparison in src/path_policy.rs:65: raw.split(|ch| ch == '/' || ch == '\\') flagged for replacement with array of char ['/', '\\'].
Tauri build and native smoke steps were skipped due to the clippy failure.
source_ci.other_jobs: Frontend, governance, and license checks passed.

changes: Wait for root_seen (Component::RootDir) and is_absolute() before metadata inspection in reject_reparse_components, ensuring verbatim Windows prefixes (\\?\C:) are not inspected prior to appending the root separator.
Inspect every following path component once root_seen and is_absolute are satisfied, preserving strict rejection of traversal (..), symlinks, junctions, ADS, UNC/device, and reserved device names.
Fail closed by enforcing path.is_absolute() and verifying root_seen upon loop completion, ensuring no path lacking an explicit root directory can bypass inspection and return Ok.
Replace closure pattern with char array ['/', '\\'] in resolve_cwd raw.split call (path_policy.rs:65) resolving clippy::manual_pattern_char_comparison without allow pragmas or weaker lints.
Keep real PowerShell output, process exit, descendant PID/termination, session-independence, and anti-echo assertions active; production PTY and IPC behavior are unchanged.
Add regression unit test reject_reparse_components_rejects_parent_traversal and verify both standard disk and canonical verbatim roots in canonical_workspace_root_components_can_be_inspected.

Add unit test reject_reparse_components_rejects_paths_without_root_directory verifying fail-closed rejection of relative paths, empty paths, verbatim drive prefixes without root, drive-relative paths, and rooted paths without drive.

standalone_logic_test.result: verified standard temp_dir, canonical verbatim temp_dir, nested dir, traversal rejection, and 5 fail-closed rootless path cases
